title: kyllinga biglumis
intro: Kyllinga biglumis, commonly known as Kyllinga or water pygmyweed, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Kyllinga biglumis include soothing skin irritations, reducing fever, and supporting the immune system. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
